facts.fact: 苏齐承认自己没忍住，跑去告诉艾琳妮去报警，因为看不下去她折磨朱迪思
facts.anchor: I couldn’t bear what she was doing to you, and I could see that she could have kept it up for days.

facts.fact: 朱迪思说自己不再管艾琳妮了，有两个死者该得到公道，要趁还能帮上忙时帮他们
facts.anchor: There are two dead people who deserve justice, so I suggest we try and help them while we can

facts.fact: 朱迪思翻《马洛维安》杂志，想到它报道镇上所有活动、含上流活动照片
facts.anchor: It covers everything that happens in the town

facts.fact: 苏齐在领主舞会照片里认出站在 Lord Harleyford 两侧的加里·怀斯和迈克·萨克森
facts.anchor: One of them was Gary Wise and the other was Mike Saxon

facts.fact: 三人开苏齐的面包车到霍尔波特破败的旅馆门口
facts.anchor: the three women drove in Suzie’s van to Holyport, where they parked up outside the run-down hotel

facts.fact: 旅馆前台说迈克·萨克森只按小时订房，从不过夜
facts.anchor: He was one of those men who book a room, but never for the night

facts.fact: 苏齐用要在 Tripadvisor 上写差评相威胁，逼前台开口
facts.anchor: I’m going to go to Tripadvisor and list everything that’s wrong with this hotel

facts.fact: 前台认出照片里的人是加里·怀斯的妻子贝思尼
facts.anchor: It was Gary Wise’s wife, Bethany.
